title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — September 19, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.3 (Peaked September 19, 2026 at 18:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 420 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

The Sun is about 93 million miles away. That's quite a commute. 💫💛

A broad coronal-hole region is the Sun’s main visible feature today, while the coronagraph shows ordinary streamers without a clear CME.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
